customers.company: Vainu & Billetto: A Case Study in Data-Driven Sales Excellence
customers.evidence:
## The same static data as everyone else

Before Vainu, Billetto only had access to static B2B data: company name, VAT number, address, number of employees, revenue. As Chief Sales Officer Martin Nørtoft puts it, that is fine if you do not know you could get more, but it is also limited, because it is what all your competitors get and you do not get the newest data necessarily. Rich B2B data was hard to come by in Denmark, which held back more nuanced market strategies, and Billetto wanted a provider whose coverage spanned the whole Nordic region, plus a way to differentiate its market approach and lift conversion rates.

> When we chose Vainu, it was because we could get access to e-commerce data, social media data, we could get access to whether the company was still active, we could do keyword search, we could do so many other things than just basic filtering data.

Martin Nørtoft, Chief Sales Officer · Billetto

## More than basic filtering

Billetto chose Vainu for more than basic filtering data: e-commerce data, social media data, whether a company is still active, and keyword search. Working with that data, the team improved its understanding of its ideal customer profile and generated more leads that were genuinely relevant. New customers are enriched automatically by matching their VAT number against Vainu’s data, so Billetto knows more about its existing organizers than it did before. Vainu is also integrated with Slack, so the team gets the most relevant notifications about changes at target companies and can contact them proactively.

> \[Vainu\] should have a hundred percent market share in Denmark... There’s no objection other than price that is valid, and the price objection will only be valid if you don’t understand the return on the investment.
> 
> Martin Nørtoft, Chief Sales Officer

More leads and a better understanding of the marketEnriching incoming leads automatically via VAT numberStaying up to date with the latest changes at target companies through Slack notifications

customers.company: LocalTapiola: €1.5 M+ saved in customer service | Vainu
customers.evidence:
## Too little known about the customer on the call

Pehkonen realized their sales and customer service were not running smoothly enough, threatening LocalTapiola’s core promise of service. Internal processes took too long and customer meetings were inefficient, because employees knew too little about their customers. Secondly, booking new meetings was an area where new sales opportunities were lost due to a lack of information. Jari Peltola, LocalTapiola Capital Region’s Customer Relations Director, is responsible for 70 insurance salespersons looking for new B2C and B2B customers, and daily more than 500 staff hours go into contacting new potential clients. Before Vainu, those hours were spent calling through static lists of companies, with the same pitch from company to company, and several daily possibilities were missed for lack of customer knowledge. For an experienced director, the situation was not sustainable.

> Our first call resolution has gone up from 75 percent to around 90 percent. Also, our contact volume has gone down about 20 percent, and our net benefit can be counted in millions. And we’re just getting started.

Sakari Pehkonen, Financial Director · LocalTapiola

## Company data in BI and CRM, and segments worth calling

LocalTapiola spent three months pinpointing the issue and ultimately understood they simply needed more data on their customers. Vainu provides LocalTapiola with corporate data and analytics integrated with their own BI and CRM data, combined with an AI-powered technology called Vainu View, which provides a comprehensive look at the customer when contacted. As Pehkonen puts it, they now know how a customer’s business is going, what is written in the news, and whether new people are coming into the company, all of which gives them a lot to talk about. On the booking side, the solution was formed in cooperation with Vainu and LocalTapiola staff and started by identifying the most profitable target segments. Three distinct segments were identified, salespersons were interviewed to find the best ways to convince decision-makers in each, and Vainu CEO Mikko Honkanen wrote three pitches to fit every target group. Vainu’s company information then supplied the list of companies, divided into the new segments. Starting from the first week of the new way of booking, hit rate increased by 23 percent, which statistically means 40 more meetings per quarter for LocalTapiola Capital Region and an estimated 200,000 euros increased yearly revenue with the current closing hit rate. Contact volume has gone down about 20 percent.

Vainu features used

- → Company Profiles
- → Data Updates

>

customers.company: 90% more effective prospecting with Vainu | Case Consultify
customers.evidence:
## Prospecting took a whole day

Consultify was founded in late 2016 in Kalmar by three brothers, with the goal of building a staffing company operating across the Nordics. The salespeople looked for new customers through time-consuming web searches, working with many tabs open in the browser and manually piecing together everything they could find about each company. A salesperson could spend a whole day prospecting.

> Previously, our salespeople could spend a whole day prospecting. Now the same job is done with one search in Vainu. We find better prospects while spending a staggering 90% less time on prospecting.

Rasmus Kallemby, Head of Sales and Co-Founder · Consultify

## Triggers, a map, and Pipedrive

Consultify adopted Vainu in August 2017, and it took less than a week before the first new customer came through the tool. The team focuses on companies in the south of Sweden in industries with a lot of physical labour, such as construction and janitorial work, so they use Vainu’s sales triggers mainly to surface companies recruiting within those focus areas, and the map functionality to find organisations operating where Consultify is active. Shortly after, they adopted Pipedrive CRM and connected it with Vainu’s two-way CRM integration, so promising prospects move straight from Vainu into the CRM and the team can track how each prospect has been handled and when the timing is right for a new touchpoint.

customers.company: Labroc: prospecting cut from two days to two hours | Vainu
customers.evidence:
## Selling was disorganised and slow

At the beginning of 2020, Labroc’s management set new sales targets that called for a proper sales process and a new set of tools. The existing way of selling was disorganised, time-consuming and frustrating. Preparing an up-to-date prospect list for the team could take days, and third-party lists were often riddled with outdated information. Labroc has no dedicated sales team either: researchers whose main job is analysing samples in the lab also sell, so anything new had to be simple, and it had to fit into a highly customised CRM.

> Our transformation was about establishing a crystal clear goal and a routine for our sales. The insights provided by Vainu’s data are inseparable from our sales process and fundamental for the team’s success every day.

Leo Partanen, CEO · Labroc

## Company data that lives in the CRM

Labroc rethought the whole sales process, put a systematic routine in place and connected Vainu to its CRM. A data enrichment process runs in the background, so the company database stays automatically up to date and reps have the information they need, including financial data, directly in the CRM without toggling between systems. The same integration feeds dynamic customer segments: the team builds a segment with filters and assigns tasks from it. Prospecting that used to take up to two days now takes roughly two hours, and time once spent compiling lists, reading company websites and checking details before meetings goes to customer work instead.

Vainu features used

- → Company Profiles
- → Data Updates
- → Workflow Triggers

> Integrating Vainu’s data into our CRM system is fantastic and brings ease and structure to everyone’s work. Now we can create a new customer segment with various filters and assign tasks efficiently.
> 
> Leo Partanen, CEO at Labroc

customers.company: Lead management process made easy with Vainu | Case: Exsitec
customers.evidence:
## No structured way of prospecting

In 2019, when Pernilla Chis joined Exsitec as the company’s first BDR, the sales team used multiple company databases and vendors, and the sales process involved a lot of manual work, from generating lists to researching the companies. “Everybody had their own ways and methods for finding new leads, and there wasn’t a structured way of prospecting. We had Google Drive full of outdated company lists our sales reps could buy whenever they wanted. They rang a few times to these companies, and the lists were of no use after that. You know the drill,” Pernilla recalls. “There were experienced people in the sales team with extensive networks for lead sources. As the team grew, naturally, not all had that kind of a network in place.” As the sales team kept growing, so did the need for one trusted company data vendor and scalable sales processes. Pernilla spearheaded a project to get sales and marketing working together on lead generation, and went looking for the right prospecting tool.

> We’ve become substantially more effective in finding and qualifying prospects. Instead of tens of sales reps using a lot of time browsing several websites, we get up-to-date company lists and a good idea about any company’s potential in a few minutes using Vainu.

Pernilla Chis, Sales and Marketing Manager in CRM & Ecommerce · Exsitec

## One prospecting process for 30 reps

Exsitec built a single prospecting process on Vainu, and today it saves 30 sales reps time they put back into customer conversations and meeting preparation. Pernilla keeps Vainu open in Chrome as her go-to place to look up a company, and uses it to qualify inbound leads with a quick check before passing them to a rep. The sales team generates dynamic target groups by industry, size, revenue and technologies in use, then sends those companies to HubSpot CRM with the relevant data points so records stay current. They upload lists of existing clients to find look-alikes and filter out the next best candidates, and they read full company profiles before making contact, including research on companies in Sweden, Norway and Denmark for M&A purposes. For campaigns, the team picks out accounts using a particular technology, such as Mailchimp, a specific CRM or an e-commerce system, sends them to HubSpot and targets them through email sequences. Pernilla also used Vainu to plan an event, checking how the target businesses were spread geographically to choose the location. The key to adoption was involving the new sales trainees in the implementation. Pernilla’s estimate: a minute or two saved at each step of the sales process adds up to hundreds of hours a month in a sales team this size.

Vainu features used

- → Company Profiles
- → Workflow Triggers
- → Data Updates

> After comparing several company data vendors, we chose Vainu because it felt more premium, and the tech side more profound. We always want to work with the best partners and the best tools.
> 
> Pernilla Chis, Sales and Marketing Manager in CRM & Ecommerce at Exsitec

customers.company: How Infomedia uses Vainu to better understand its customers and market
customers.evidence:
## Missing the data points to crack it

Infomedia’s goal was to improve growth and profitability, and that meant understanding its customers and its market better. “We wanted to understand our customers and the potential in the market a little bit better to secure our growth targets but also, of course, understand a little bit better what we’re good at for the kinds of companies that typically look into our offerings and also, of course, to secure profitability on all levels within the business,” explains Dennis Mølgaard, Country Manager, Denmark at Infomedia. Consultancy firms quoted him very expensive offers for the ICP analysis, and he concluded he could do much of it in house. Internal analysis on Infomedia’s own data gave a clear picture, but not a complete one: “I could probably do a lot of this myself, but I couldn’t take it all the way because we were missing some data points.”

> Vainu did some magic, and we, together, came up with a better understanding of how to actually segment our market.

Dennis Mølgaard, Country Manager, Denmark · Infomedia

## Segmentation first, then triggers

Infomedia runs a fairly basic setup: it enriches its accounts with Vainu data, which was straightforward to connect because Infomedia uses Salesforce and Vainu has a native Salesforce integration. “We use Vainu data to enrich our CRM... We have a fairly basic setup with Vainu where we enrich our accounts with different kinds of data,” Dennis explains. The joint ICP analysis and the segmentation of Infomedia’s total addressable market formed the bedrock of the most recent Vainu-Infomedia collaboration. With the segments defined, the team saw the potential of Workflow Triggers and built a workflow that fires automatically when an account meets their criteria on a number of data points, including number of employees, social media index, website keywords and website rank. “That did the trick. We ran a lot of tests...to see if this would fit, and I actually think it fits 70-80% of the time, which is really really good,” Dennis says of the trigger setup.

> Vainu did some magic, and we, together, came up with a better understanding of how to actually segment our market.
> 
> Dennis Mølgaard, Country Manager, Denmark

customers.company: Improving Sales Funnel | Case Vainu & Academic Work
customers.evidence:
## Two prospecting tools, one meeting in five calls

Academic Work had set a goal of growing annual turnover to 100 million euros by 2022, which meant the sales organisation needed tools that could keep up with it. Before Vainu, every fifth phone call led to a meeting. The team started with Vainu in autumn 2014 and ran it side by side with a competing prospecting tool from Fonecta. Academic Work also aims at the most efficient processing of its industry: every salesperson needs to be able to process 100% of their portfolio, which is especially important as the company hires more and more employees and the size of one’s portfolio diminishes.

> All our sales prospecting in Finland, Sweden, and Norway is done through Vainu, and our employees are nuts about it! Vainu Analyzer, on the other hand, is an amazing tool for improving our salespeople’s prospect and customer portfolios. Everyone uses Vainu, and it’s a part of the onboarding process of every new salesperson.

Jukka Pulkkinen, Head of Sales · Academic Work

## One prospecting tool, and a quarterly look at every portfolio

“We saw pretty quickly that everyone began using just Vainu. Well, it was quite unnecessary to pay for two, so we resigned the competitor,” says Head of Sales Jukka Pulkkinen. All sales prospecting in Finland, Sweden and Norway now runs through Vainu, and it is part of the onboarding of every new salesperson. Alongside prospecting, salespeople use Vainu Analyzer to work their portfolios: every salesperson runs their portfolio through it once a quarter and, based on the data, drops the prospects they do not have time for or do not think are worth the time. Managers use Analyzer too. Account Manager and Team Manager Timo Koiso-Kanttila analyses his team’s customer portfolios in Analyzer and fine-tunes sales alignment from what he finds. With an established portfolio he has shifted from pure new-business search to monitoring: he uses Vainu’s static lists to follow what his clients are doing, what projects they have coming, and when resourcing is likely to be on their agenda. Across three years of customership, the team logged in to Vainu more than 50,000 times, with over 60 unique users in the week the interview took place.

> With Vainu, I get good-quality and up-to-date data to be at the right place at the right time.
> 
> Timo Koiso-Kanttila, Account Manager / Team Manager

customers.company: More meetings with less prospecting | Case Vainu & RecRight
customers.evidence:
## The ideal customer was not in any list

RecRight’s software gets the best response from companies that receive many applications to their open positions, believe in modern technologies, and want to invest in their employer brand image and applicant experience. That profile cannot be found in traditional company databases or lists. RecRight first implemented Vainu in the spring of 2016, and Miikka Tuomola, who joined as Sales Director in August 2017, wants to bring a systematic approach to RecRight’s sales process. The team measures the number of meetings, offers and deals.

> With the help of Vainu, it’s effortless to identify the companies with many open positions using other SaaS technologies. Pipedrive CRM integration lets us easily filter out our current customers and the companies we’ve recently contacted. Thanks to this, our time spent on prospecting has decreased by 67% from what it was before Vainu.

Miikka Tuomola, Sales Director · RecRight

## Open positions, tech, a filtered CRM

The team uses Vainu to identify companies with many open positions that are already using other SaaS technologies, and the Pipedrive CRM integration filters out current customers and companies they have recently contacted. As the product grew to include an ATS, Vainu’s ATS technology search let them focus on companies still gathering job applications by email. They also began using Vainu’s Swedish company database to find accounts matching their ideal customer profile and follow account insights related to them, and they follow funding and internationalisation signals to spot young and innovative companies focused on international growth. Vainu paid for itself once RecRight identified its first new customer with it.
